cards.text: REPLACE: journal entry, about 80 words. Write it yourself, this is the most personal thing on the board and it is what the ink check reads. Say what this year felt like, what you kept putting off, and the one thing you would be sad to still be saying next November. Keep the sentences the way you would actually write them in a notebook, short ones and long ones, with a line you might cross out later. End on something you believe.
cards.pencilGuess: Which line here will you still agree with in June?
